entries.name: fal-ai-media
entries.detail: The skill is a guide to fal.ai's hosted generation endpoints (Veo, Kling, Seedance, Nano Banana) and ElevenLabs. Those are paid, hosted AI generation services, which the corpus excludes: it covers open-source and local-hostable tools only.
